[[File:Bothawui_shield_generator.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The planetary shield generator on [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]], c. [[3671 BBY]]]]

A '''planetary shield''', commonly known as a '''planetary deflector shield''' (or '''defense grid'''), was a large scale [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]] designed to protect an entire [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombardment]], falling debris, or other hazards. The term ''planetary shield'' may also have been used for a large scale shield protecting a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] such as [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]].

==Description==
Planetary shields were layers of invisible energy generated by [[planetary shield generator]]s which had enough power to dissipate [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] blasts and to deflect and destroy space debris such as [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]] and [[Comet/Legends|comets]]. [[Starship/Legends|Starships]] coming into contact with a planetary shield were usually destroyed or severely damaged. Due to the shields being invisible to the naked eye, [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] were required to detect the presence of raised shields around a [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>

The energy requirements to keep a planetary shield operational were enormous; as a result, planetary shields were often kept deactivated and only powered up when needed. Some models of planetary shield required as long as half an [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] to activate and bring to full strength. In these cases, planets employed a network of turbolaser and [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] emplacements to hold enemy forces at bay until the shield was operational.<ref name="EGWT" />

Shield generators were strategically stationed on the planet's surface. Since the deflector shield generator required a continuous supply of energy output the maintenance costs for such a protection device were generally high. This is the main reason why planetary shields were usually constructed on planets that had important military installations, served as major commercial hubs, or had a significantly large number of inhabitants which could economically support such an expensive project.

The strength of a planetary deflector shield was a factor depending on how close the shield was to the projector, the efficiency of the projector, the power applied, and the surface area of the shield.

==History==
[[File:AlderaanPlanetaryShield-GOM.png|thumb|left|200px|[[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan's]] shield overwhelmed by the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star's]] [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]].]]

The first [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] were developed to protect individual [[Starship/Legends|starships]] against various [[Realspace/Legends|space]] hazards including attacks from other ships. The technology was later adapted for use aboard [[Space station/Legends|space stations]], but the shields remained best suited to repelling [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]].

Shield technology was first expanded from protecting starships to entire [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in [[3631 BBY]] to protect [[Odessen]]. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Juvard Illip Oggurobb]] developed the technology on behalf of the [[Eternal Alliance|Alliance]] in time for [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Arcann]]'s attack at the [[Battle of Odessen]]. The planetary shield prevented the [[Eternal Fleet]] from bombarding the [[Alliance base]] and forced the battle to be space-based confrontation.<ref name="Chapter 16">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|chapter=16}}</ref>

Planetary shields could be scaled to cover bases, [[City/Legends|cities]], or even entire planets. One of the two main types of planetary shields, '''encasing shields''' (like the [[Death Star II/Legends|second Death Star's]]), prohibited friendly fire from beneath the shield except through small gaps. Encasing shields could be curved to protect orbiting objects and seriously damaged the systems of craft that passed through them. The second type of planetary shield, a '''shutter shield''', was more versatile in that segments could be moved to overlap others for increased defense, but shutter shields did less damage to craft passing through them and could not be oriented in a curve. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Echo Base/Legends|base]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] employed shutter shields. Both types of planetary shields fouled [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] scans.<ref name="Hideouts & Strongholds">''[[Hideouts & Strongholds]]''</ref>

Pacifistic planets like [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]<ref name="ANHn">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]</ref> and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]],<ref name="AOTC:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref> often relied on passive defenses like planetary shields instead of using more aggressive measures to ensure the populace's safety. The former was stated to be as strong as the defensive systems of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].<ref name="ANHn" />

[[Battle station/Legends|Battlestations]] such as [[Torpedo Sphere/Legends|Torpedo Spheres]] or [[Death Star/Legends|Death Stars]] were designed to penetrate planetary shields. When such weapons were unavailable, planetary shields were often sabotaged as a prelude to either conquest (as in the [[Subjugation of Mon Calamari|conquest of Mon Calamari]]), or an [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]] (as in the [[Caamas Firestorm|destruction of Caamas]] or the [[Battle of Bothawui (Galactic Civil War)|Second Battle of Bothawui]]).
